facts.text: I am planning a baby gift for my sister-in-law Rachel's new baby boy, Ethan.
I want to recommend some good online stores for personalized baby blankets.
I am thinking of getting a blanket with a cute design and Ethan's name embroidered on it.
I am considering whether to choose a soft pastel color or something bold and bright for the blanket.
I am thinking of getting onesies and sleepers to go along with the blanket.
I am considering neutral colors like white, gray, and beige for the onesies and sleepers.
I am considering brighter colors and fun designs for the onesies and sleepers.
I will go with a mix of neutral and fun colors for the onesies and sleepers.
I will get onesies and sleepers with cute designs like animals or stripes.
I will get onesies and sleepers in neutral colors like white and gray.
I am considering whether to get 0-3 month sizes or stick with 3-6 month sizes for onesies and sleepers.
I am considering getting sleep sacks or swaddles to go along with the onesies and sleepers.
I am considering whether to get sleep sacks or swaddles with fun designs or neutral colors.
I will stick to neutral colors and simple designs for the sleep sacks and swaddles.
I am considering getting a baby book or journal as an addition to the gift.
